LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_OperatorIncapab: The operator must be capable of Intellectual work
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_OfferLetterText:
A cautious Tok'ra contact has opened a narrow channel. The cell is not offering a sensitive mission. It asks only that your colony discreetly watch for unusual Goa'uld movement in the surrounding region and later transmit a concise report.
Select a colonist, then right-click the powered Tok'ra secure communicator to accept the request. The channel will remain available for about {0} hours. Letting it close carries no trust penalty.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_OfferExpired: The cautious Tok'ra observation channel has closed without a response.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_Accepted: {0} has accepted the Tok'ra observation request. A useful report can be transmitted after about {1} hours of discreet monitoring.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_ReportReady: The requested observation period is complete. A colonist can now transmit the report through the Tok'ra communicator.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_FailedLetterTex: The observation request was accepted, but the report was not transmitted before the secure window closed. The Tok'ra cell will be more cautious about relying on the colony.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_SuccessLetterTe: {0} has transmitted a concise report on nearby Goa'uld activity. The Tok'ra cell confirms that the information was useful. The operator gains {1} Intellectual XP, and the cell's trust in the colony improves.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropNoLonge: This Tok'ra intelligence module is no longer part of an active operation
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropWindowE: The Tok'ra intelligence recovery window has closed
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropCannotR: No safe path to the Tok'ra intelligence module
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropReserve: Another colonist has reserved the Tok'ra intelligence module
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropSpawnFa: No valid location could be found at the Tok'ra delivery zone, near a powered communicator or at the map edge. The request remains available.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropOfferLe:
A Tok'ra cell wants to entrust the colony with a sealed module containing encrypted intelligence on Goa'uld activity. Accepting the request authorizes delivery to the Tok'ra delivery zone. If no valid zone exists, the delivery point will be chosen near a powered communicator and then at the map edge.
Select a colonist, then right-click the powered Tok'ra secure communicator to accept the recovery. The offer will remain available for about {0} hours. An Intellectual-capable colonist must then secure the module. This operation represents extracting and transmitting the data; the container provides no recoverable item. Ignoring the offer carries no trust penalty.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropOfferEx: The Tok'ra intelligence recovery request has closed without a response.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropAccepte: {0} has accepted the Tok'ra intelligence recovery. The data must be secured within about {1} hours.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropLocated: An encrypted Tok'ra intelligence module has been delivered to the selected delivery point. Send an Intellectual-capable colonist to secure it within about {0} hours. Securing the module represents checking its integrity, extracting its data and transmitting it to the cell. It contains no recoverable supplies.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropTimedOu: The request was accepted, but the data in the Tok'ra module was not secured before the contact window closed. The cell will be more cautious about relying on the colony.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropLostLet: The request was accepted, but the Tok'ra intelligence module was lost or destroyed before its data could be extracted. The cell will be more cautious about relying on the colony.
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropSuccess: {0} checked the module, extracted its encrypted intelligence and confirmed transmission to the Tok'ra cell. The operator gains {1} Intellectual XP, and the cell's trust in the colony improves.

LanguageData.GR_TokraTrust_OrganicObservationSucceede: The Tok'ra cell acknowledges the value of the observation report. Its posture toward the colony improves.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTrust_OrganicObservationFailed: The missed observation report makes the Tok'ra cell slightly more cautious.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTrust_OrganicDeadDropSucceeded: The Tok'ra cell confirms that the encrypted intelligence was recovered and transmitted without incident. Its confidence in the colony improves.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTrust_OrganicDeadDropFailed: The failed intelligence recovery makes the Tok'ra cell slightly more cautious.
